steps.title: Prepare Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 96-well deep-well plate by adding Proteinase K and sample.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 5 ul of proteinase k to each sample well.
Add 50 ul of sample to each well (this can be increased up to 200 ul if volume is available).
Bring the total volume in each well to 200 ul using molecular biology grade H2O (e.g., add 150 ul H2O if 50 ul sample was used; adjust H2O volume accordingly if sample volume was increased).

steps.title: Prepare Binding Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a Binding Bead Mix with a 15-20% overage to account for pipetting loss.

substeps.instruction: Combine 265 ul Binding Solution and 10 ul Magnetic Beads per well for a total volume of 275 ul.
Pipette slowly as the binding solution is very viscous.

steps.title: Add Binding Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Add 275 ul of the prepared Binding Bead mix to each sample well and pipette to mix slowly to avoid froth and well-to-well contamination.

steps.title: Prepare DNase Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNase solution and keep it on ice until needed.

substeps.instruction: Combine 48 ul Turbo Dnase buffer and 2 ul Turbo Dnase (2 U/µL, Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM2238) per well for a total volume of 50 ul.

steps.title: Initiate KingFisher Extraction
steps.instruction: Run the MVPII_withdnase.bdz program on the Kingfisher Flex (Automated Extraction System, ThermoFisher, 5400630), adding the plates from previous steps when prompted.

steps.title: Perform Mid-Protocol DNase Plate Addition
steps.instruction: Approximately 30 minutes into the protocol, when prompted, remove the DNAse plate from the Kingfisher and add the following to each sample well:

substeps.instruction: Add 150 ul molecular biology grade isopropanol.

steps.title: Complete DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Return the DNase plate to the Kingfisher and press start to continue the protocol.

steps.title: Store Eluted RNA
steps.instruction: Once the run is finished, remove the elution plate, seal it, and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Optional Quality Control
steps.instruction: Run a sub-sample of extracted RNA on a Bioanalyzer or Tape Station to verify RNA quality and DNA removal.

substeps.instruction: Use Bioanalyzer 6000 Pico RNA kit (Agilent Technologies Catalog #5067-1513).
Use Bioanalyzer 6000 RNA Pico Ladder (Agilent Technologies Catalog #5067-1535).
